The track investments were $1,487 million out of a total cash capital investment of $2,242 million for 2006.  
\[
\frac{1{,}487}{2{,}242}\times100\% \approx 66.35\%
\]  
**66.35 %** of Union Pacific’s total cash capital investments for the year ended December 31, 2006 were allocated to track investments. [D2269_C1]
